operations.create: Create one task-scoped STATE.json through current_admission.build_initial_state.
operations.read: Read the task STATE.json and its exact referenced artifacts; observe_article returns the validated stage and next action.
operations.update: Change requirements through current_admission.apply_task_requirement_change; preserve append-only history and invalidate dependent evidence.
operations.delete: Do not erase historical receipts or accepted evidence. Retire requirements/methods through lifecycle operations; delete only disposable unreferenced temporary artifacts.
operations.delivery: Store actual DOCX, render receipts and verified page evidence under the same article delivery workspace.

external_inputs.chat: Source of user intent and explicit approval; never a shadow article-state store.
external_inputs.research_sources: Evidence inputs with exact source, date and content provenance.
external_inputs.github_provider: Durable file storage and exact read/write/readback authority.
external_inputs.temporary_files: Ephemeral work products only; never canonical state.
